image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim coloration) resting on a rumpled grey blanket. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches on the ears and around the eyes, and a distinct red lozenge mark on the forehead. The dog is looking directly at the camera with large, dark eyes. The background consists of vertical wooden slats.
